feedback: Your unified interface concept sounds interesting - bringing together code, project tracking, and documentation could solve real workflow fragmentation issues. To help you define this product properly, I need to understand the specific problem you're solving, who will use it, and what success looks like.

questions.description: What specific problem does this unified interface solve? What pain points do users currently experience with fragmented tools?
questions.placeholder: Describe the core problem your product addresses

questions.description: Who is your primary target audience? (e.g., individual developers, small teams, enterprise teams, specific roles)
questions.placeholder: Describe your target users and their characteristics

questions.description: What specific input sources and tools do you plan to integrate? (e.g., GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Slack, etc.)
questions.placeholder: List the tools and data sources you want to unify

questions.description: What will users be able to do in this unified interface? What are the key features and workflows?
questions.placeholder: Describe the main features and user workflows

questions.description: How will you measure success? What outcomes should this product achieve for users?
questions.placeholder: Define what success looks like for your users

questions.description: What would be the minimum viable version of this product? What's the smallest version that would provide value?
questions.placeholder: Describe your MVP - the simplest version that solves the core problem

questions.description: Do you have any timeline constraints or target launch dates?
questions.placeholder: e.g., '6 months to MVP', 'Need to launch by Q3', or 'No specific deadline'

questions.description: Are there any specific technical requirements, integrations, or constraints we should know about?
questions.placeholder: Describe any technical considerations, API requirements, security needs, etc.

questions.description: Are you aware of existing solutions in this space? What would make your approach different?
questions.placeholder: Describe the competitive landscape and your differentiation
